The [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] '''WhisperThrust Engine''' was an illegal, military-grade, [[baffled drive]] designed for use in [[Starship/Legends|ships]] sizes up to a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. Utilizing supercooled gases and specialized engine nacelles designed to scatter escaping gas, the WhisperThrust was specifically designed as to leave as little [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] wake as possible, allowing for a virtually undetectable cruising speed through [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. High speeds and sudden bursts from the engines were capable of being detected however, necessitating low to medium speeds for movement.
